liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ramble On Rose** (2 reviews): Performance singled out as especially strong and tight; Reviewer rates it among the best versions ever, with an over-the-top jam [7][8]
- **Corrina** (2 reviews): Its opening sounds to the reviewer like Garcia is about to play Iron Man; The mid-section jam is singled out for rock-solid Garcia playing [12][14]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Opener described as hot [9]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 review): Garcia's run at the end of Vince's solo gives the reviewer goosebumps [9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Garcia playing its chords during second-set tuning snapped the reviewer out of a stupor [13]
- **Way To Go Home** (1 review): After Vince announced it, Garcia joked that it was a way to ruin the evening [12]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Garcia plays some of his fastest, most striking runs of notes here [8]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): Garcia's solo at the end is praised [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-03-10.sbd.tetzeli-fix.35215.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd93-03-10.sbd.ladner.2024.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 3.82/5 by 22 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording very clean; Sound quality is very good but not extremely crisp [7][11]
- **gd1993-03-10.120543.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1993-03-10.AKG451.Darby.119635.Flac1644**: audience recording; 18 songs; 160 min [4]

## Around the show

- Garcia seemed relatively healthy and clean during this run, and the playing reflects it [7]
- Attendee with a scanner overheard the band's onstage side conversations about what to play [12]
- Garcia rarely said good night to the audience at the end, apparently pleased [15]
- A sudden quiet between the Drums and Space tracks is genuinely part of the show, not a tape cut [1]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best shows of 1993 [8]
- Performance judged above average, with good singing and solos [11]
- Reviewer considers it a below-average show for 1993 [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-03-10.sbd.tetzeli-fix.35215.shnf**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Seamless fix of shn id 2024 [1]. Also: Uploader joined the transition between CDs 2 and 3 seamlessly [1]
- **gd93-03-10.sbd.ladner.2024.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd > DAT master > analog > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [3]
- **gd1993-03-10.120543.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Dat (44.1k) [2]
- **gd1993-03-10.AKG451.Darby.119635.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451EB/CK1's (DIN/Section 2 Row 49 Seat 5/6 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Set 1:Sony Metal-ES,Set… [4]
